headline: Verisk (VRSK) CIO Nick Daffan Steps Down After Two Decades As CTO Fills In
summary: Verisk Analytics (NasdaqGS:VRSK) announced a leadership transition as Executive Vice President and Chief Information Officer Nick Daffan stepped down after roughly two decades with the company. The company said its Chief Technology Officer will assume Daffan's responsibilities on an interim basis while Verisk evaluates longer term leadership plans for the role.
